post.author: Christine Gwinnup
post.body: What a pain in the rear this month has been! I would have never guessed that removing popcorn off of our ceilings would be this difficult.  I say this as if I'm the one scraping them myself... but the reality is Drew has done it all.  My complaints include, sleeping on couches, not being able to find my slippers and eating out every day while we wait for the work to be completed.  He has moved everything out of our bedroom and kitchen and our furniture is in the living room and my dressing room.  I can't wait to see the finished product!
